observations: Front-loading washing machine with a circular door.
LG logo visible on the top left of the control panel.
DirectDrive 7kg label visible on the left side of the control panel.
Control panel includes a central rotary dial, buttons for wash programs, spin, and temperature.
A sticker on the right side says 'ON MOTOR 10 YEARS WARRANTY'.
The machine shows significant surface rust and wear, especially on the lower front panel.
The door seal appears torn and dirty.
The interior drum is visible through the glass door but is dark and appears empty or dirty.
The machine is sitting on a concrete floor in what looks like a workshop or storage area.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the LG logo and DirectDrive 7kg label on the control panel.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or may have internal motor damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powering on, the display lighting up, and the drum spinning.

risks.risk: The drum may be damaged or have internal wear not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video showing the drum rotating freely and the interior being inspected.

risks.risk: The door seal may be torn and leaking water, which is not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video showing the door being opened and closed, and water being poured in to check for leaks.

risks.risk: The machine may have hidden mechanical faults or timing issues.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running through a full wash cycle.

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker with the model number (usually inside the door or on the back).
Video of the machine powering on and running a full wash cycle.
Video showing the drum spinning and the door seal being tested for leaks.
Photo of the back of the machine showing the power cord and any model number plate.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
